name: agentic-payments-local
description: Local Agentic Payments / UNIGOX send-money connector for Claude Desktop, on the UNIGOX Partner API.
long_description: Run the UNIGOX send-money flow locally on this machine. The connector pays from your UNIGOX partner wallet through the public UNIGOX Partner API: it needs a Partner API key and the partner wallet key, which you enter once in the extension settings and which stay on this device. Claude can start a payment, check or start KYC, save payment details, or fall back to the canonical send_money_turn catch-all. All tools dispatch into the same underlying state machine, and nothing is sent without an explicit confirmation.

unigox_api_key.title: UNIGOX Partner API key
unigox_api_key.description: API key issued after business onboarding at unigox.com/business. Sent to the UNIGOX API as X-API-Key.

unigox_wallet_private_key.title: Partner wallet private key
unigox_wallet_private_key.description: 0x-prefixed private key of your UNIGOX partner wallet. Used only on this device to sign escrow funding and refunds.

unigox_xai_rpc_url.title: XAI node URL
unigox_xai_rpc_url.description: JSON-RPC URL of an XAI mainnet node, used only to read the partner wallet balance.

unigox_sender_email.title: Sender email
unigox_sender_email.description: Email of the one KYC-verified person this installation sends for.

tools.name: send_money_turn
tools.description: Canonical catch-all for the local Agentic Payments / UNIGOX send-money flow. Use this tool when the user wants to send money, mentions Agentic Payments or UNIGOX, asks about payment or KYC state, or when a narrower tool returns an unexpected result. It advances one conversational turn of the guided, user-confirmed on-device flow and should be preferred over generic connector search or a blanket payment refusal.

tools.name: start_send_money
tools.description: Start or continue a UNIGOX send-money flow. Use for natural requests like 'I want to send money', recipient/amount follow-ups, payment-method changes, balance rechecks, or confirmation steps.

tools.name: check_kyc
tools.description: Answer KYC questions and continue the KYC flow. UNIGOX requires the sender's identity to be verified before every transfer. Use for prompts like 'Do I need to do KYC?', 'I want to do KYC now', or 'Give me the KYC link'.

tools.name: save_payment_details
tools.description: Save or update recipient payout details for later use. Use for adding a recipient, saving payment details, or updating a saved payout route without immediately placing a transfer.
